headline: Arbitrariness Won't Be Tolerated: Government Issues Strict Order to Sugar Mills Before Festivals, Must Report Monthly Production and Sales - Sugar Prices and Supply: Ministry of Food Directs Mills to Maintain Fair Pricing as Production Estimates Drop
summary: The government has ordered sugar mills to report monthly production and sales and to maintain fair pricing as the festive season approaches. Production estimates have reportedly dropped.
why: Sugar is a major agricultural commodity in India, and government controls on mills influence domestic prices, supply and sector profitability.
